Method Overview

Our 9-stage pipeline combines automated time-series signal decomposition with 4 mandatory statistical control checks.

Detection Pipeline

  1. 1. Monthly NASA satellite telemetry ingestion & fill-flag (-999) filtering
  2. 2. 12-month centered moving-average seasonal cycle removal
  3. 3. All-pairs Theil-Sen median slope rate-of-change estimation
  4. 4. Mann-Kendall S-statistic & Multi-Parameter Score (S_trend) fit

Mandatory Control Validation Checks

  1. 1. Harmonic Cancellation: > 98% spectral attenuation at T = 12 mo
  2. 2. Outlier Breakdown Check: < 2% slope drift under 5σ spikes
  3. 3. Lag-1 Autocorrelation: Hamed-Rao effective sample size scaling
  4. 4. Sub-Window Split Stability: Monotonic sign consistency check
✓ Control-Validated Discovery MERRA-2 · CERES · GLDAS

Indus Basin & Arctic Polar Amplification Analysis

Our system independently reproduced published decadal warming and hydrologic stress rates while rejecting stationary & red-noise negative controls

Benchmark & Control Properties

Primary Region: Indus Basin (31.52°N, 74.35°E)
Polar Benchmark: Svalbard Arctic (78.22°N, 15.62°E)
Observation Span: 30 Years (1995 – 2024, 360 Months)
Negative Controls: Stationary Sine & AR(1) Rejected ✓
4 Mandatory Checks: 4 / 4 PASSED (p < 0.0001) ✓
